fix.passage: Early television analysis in the 1970s and 1980s was shaped by film studies, <u>though media scholar Horace Newcomb notes that tools borrowed from that field often proved inadequate when applied to TV’s distinct characteristics</u>. By the 1990s, television studies had emerged as a widely recognized academic field, with scholars founding dedicated journals.

Data set A has 41 values, so its median is the 21st value. The running totals are 1, 8, 16, 25, …, so the 17th through 25th values are all 3, and the median is 3. Data set B has 40 values, so its median is the average of the 20th and 21st values, which are both 3. The medians are equal; removing the outlier changes the mean, not the median here.

If x + 2b is a factor of 3x^2 + px + 18b, the other factor must be 3x + 9 (so that 2b · 9 = 18b). Then (x + 2b)(3x + 9) = 3x^2 + (9 + 6b)x + 18b, so p = 9 + 6b. Only p = 51 gives a positive integer, b = 7; 9 gives b = 0, and 30 and 42 give non-integers.
